summary: Chicago R&B star R. Kelly, abused as a child, spent decades allegedly preying on teenage girls, secretly married 15-year-old Aaliyah, beat partners and kept young women in a controlling household reporters called a sex cult.

evidence.note: born in Chicago in 1967, raised by his mother
molested by a relative from about age eight to fifteen
works with teenage Aaliyah, then secretly marries her at fifteen
Hawkins suit says the abuse began in 1991 when she was fifteen
2002 charges of making child pornography over a leaked tape
Sun-Times reporter DeRogatis receives letter and tapes, breaks story
meets Kitty Jones in 2011; long segment on her account
repeated beatings of Jones; later Andrea's abuse claims
BuzzFeed report of women kept under total control in his buildings
boycotts and falling sales up to 2018 bring story to release

notes: Recorded in January 2019, before his 2019 federal charges and 2021-2022 convictions, so the hosts frame most claims as allegations; main_span end left null as he was active at release. criminal-killer role reflects abuse being central despite the 2008 acquittal. The 'cult' is a high-control household, not a religion.
